name: Coldseam The Disgraced Judge's Last Formal Set
description:
Once a Spire governance robe, now stripped of insignia and carefully reworked into something that reads as formal without declaring allegiance. Deep charcoal wool-analog longcoat — the judicial gold trim has been unpicked, leaving ghost-lines in the weave. Beneath: a pressed high-collar shirt in off-white, slightly yellowed at the cuffs from repeated laundering. Slim formal trousers, hand-pressed. Worn black oxfords, resoled twice. A single neural port at the temple is left uncovered — the port housing is engraved with a case number that no longer exists in any public record.

Coldseam makes nothing this formal; this is a one-off commission from a tailor who asked no questions.
functionality: Formal presentation without active affiliation signaling, neural port left accessible, resoled boots for extended wear, hand-pressed construction requiring no powered maintenance.
what_it_says: Someone who once held enormous power and lost it — still carrying the posture, no longer carrying the title.
worn_by: defrocked governance officials navigating lower tiers
characters defined by a specific downfall
story_hooks: The case number engraved on the neural port housing was expunged — finding out why requires accessing a court archive that officially burned in 2189.
Someone in the Spire is paying a Shelf fixer to locate this person before they talk to a journalist.
The ghost-lines where the judicial trim was removed are visible under certain lighting — in the right circles, people still recognize what this coat used to be.
